title: Turning Left From a One-Way Street: Always Start From the Far-LEFT Curb Lane (Never From the Right/Middle Lane!)

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All visible vehicles in foreground and background face the same direction within their road; no head-on opposing pair in one lane.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Markings show yellow center on left of travel and white lane lines on right; vehicles keep to right side, no left-hand driving evident.

teaching_correct.note: Shows left turn starting from right-most lane and cutting across middle/left lanes to turn left, directly contradicting far-left origin rule.
